title: folder-sync competitor retail prices, version 1
description: bench/cost/competitors.json: what a person pays Dropbox, Google, Obsidian, Apple and Microsoft for synced storage, read from each vendor's pricing page on `as_of`. One item per plan and billing cadence. FROZEN shape (the live-history view renders it): add items, never fields. docs/COST.md explains the numbers; bench/cost/competitors.test.mjs validates the file against this schema and recomputes the two derived numbers.

name.description: Vendor and plan, as a person would say it. Not unique on its own: name + billing is.

price_usd_month.description: USD a month, list price. For billing = annual it is the yearly price divided by 12.

per_gb_month_usd.description: price_usd_month / storage_gb, rounded to 6 decimals: the price of a GB a person has bought, used or not.

per_person_month_10gb_usd.description: What a person pays this vendor a month to hold 10 GB: the price of the vendor's cheapest plan with storage_gb >= 10 at the same billing cadence (a free plan counts at either cadence). The whole plan's price, NOT pro-rated to 10 GB.

notes.description: Billing text as quoted, version-history window, and any caveat about how the price was read.
